540 void SerializeBinProperty( FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, TNotNull<void*> Data, int32 ArrayIdx = -1 )
541 {
542 FStructuredArchive::FStream Stream = Slot.EnterStream();
543 if( ShouldSerializeValue(Slot.GetUnderlyingArchive()) )
544 {
545 const int32 LoopMin = ArrayIdx < 0 ? 0 : ArrayIdx;
546 const int32 LoopMax = ArrayIdx < 0 ? ArrayDim : ArrayIdx + 1;
547 for (int32 Idx = LoopMin; Idx < LoopMax; Idx++)
548 {
549 // Keep setting the property in case something inside of SerializeItem changes it
550 FSerializedPropertyScope SerializedProperty(Slot.GetUnderlyingArchive(), this);
551 SerializeItem(Stream.EnterElement(), ContainerPtrToValuePtr<void>(Data, Idx));
552 }
553 }
554 }
555
563 void SerializeNonMatchingBinProperty(FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, TNotNull<void*> Data, void const* DefaultData, UStruct* DefaultStruct)
564 {
565 FArchive& UnderlyingArchive = Slot.GetUnderlyingArchive();
566 FStructuredArchive::FStream Stream = Slot.EnterStream();
567
568 if( ShouldSerializeValue(UnderlyingArchive) )
569 {
570 for (int32 Idx = 0; Idx < ArrayDim; Idx++)
571 {
572 void* Target = ContainerPtrToValuePtr<void>(Data, Idx);
573 void const* Default = ContainerPtrToValuePtrForDefaults<void>(DefaultStruct, DefaultData, Idx);
574 if ( !Identical(Target, Default, UnderlyingArchive.GetPortFlags()) )
575 {
576 FSerializedPropertyScope SerializedProperty(UnderlyingArchive, this);
577 SerializeItem( Stream.EnterElement(), Target, Default );
578 }
579 }
580 }
581 }

636 {
637 if (!HasSetter())
638 {
639 CopyCompleteValue(ContainerVoidPtrToValuePtrInternal(OutContainer, 0), InValue);
640 }
641 else
642 {
643 CallSetter(OutContainer, InValue);
644 }
645 }
646 inline void GetValue_InContainer(void const* InContainer, void* OutValue) const
647 {
648 if (!HasGetter())
649 {
650 CopyCompleteValue(OutValue, ContainerVoidPtrToValuePtrInternal((void*)InContainer, 0));
651 }
652 else
653 {
654 CallGetter(InContainer, OutValue);
655 }
656 }

732
733 inline void* ContainerVoidPtrToValuePtrInternal(void* ContainerPtr, int32 ArrayIndex) const
734 {
735 checkf((ArrayIndex >= 0) && (ArrayIndex < ArrayDim), TEXT("Array index out of bounds: %i from an array of size %i"), ArrayIndex, ArrayDim);
736 check(ContainerPtr);
737
738 if (0)
739 {
740 // in the future, these checks will be tested if the property is NOT relative to a UClass
741 check(!GetOwner<UClass>()); // Check we are _not_ calling this on a direct child property of a UClass, you should pass in a UObject* in that case
742 }
743
744 return (uint8*)ContainerPtr + Offset_Internal + static_cast<size_t>(GetElementSize()) * ArrayIndex;
745 }
746
747 inline void* ContainerUObjectPtrToValuePtrInternal(UObject* ContainerPtr, int32 ArrayIndex) const
748 {
749 checkf((ArrayIndex >= 0) && (ArrayIndex < ArrayDim), TEXT("Array index out of bounds: %i from an array of size %i"), ArrayIndex, ArrayDim);
750 check(ContainerPtr);
751
752 // in the future, these checks will be tested if the property is supposed be from a UClass
753 // need something for networking, since those are NOT live uobjects, just memory blocks
754 checkf(((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->IsValidLowLevel(), TEXT("%s does not belong to a valid ContainerPtr"), *GetName()); // Check its a valid UObject that was passed in
755 checkf(((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->GetClass() != NULL, TEXT("Expected that %s belongs to a class, and %s is not a class"), *GetName(), *((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->GetName());
756 checkf(GetOwner<UClass>(), TEXT("%s does not belong to a class"), *GetName()); // Check that the outer of this property is a UClass (not another property)
757
758 // Check that the object we are accessing is of the class that contains this property
759 checkf(((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->IsA(GetOwner<UClass>()), TEXT("'%s' is of class '%s' however property '%s' belongs to class '%s'")
760 , *((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->GetName()
761 , *((UObject*)ContainerPtr)->GetClass()->GetName()
762 , *GetName()
763 , *GetOwner<UClass>()->GetName());
764
765 if (0)
766 {
767 // in the future, these checks will be tested if the property is NOT relative to a UClass
768 check(!GetOwner<UClass>()); // Check we are _not_ calling this on a direct child property of a UClass, you should pass in a UObject* in that case
769 }
770
771 return (uint8*)ContainerPtr + Offset_Internal + static_cast<size_t>(GetElementSize()) * ArrayIndex;
772 }

821 // Default variants, these accept and return nullptr, and also check the property against the size of the container.
822 // If we copy from a baseclass (like for a CDO), then this will give nullptr for any property that doesn't belong to the baseclass.
823 template<typename ValueType>
824 inline ValueType* ContainerPtrToValuePtrForDefaults(const UStruct* ContainerClass, UObject* ContainerPtr, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
825 {
826 if (ContainerPtr && IsInContainer(ContainerClass))
827 {
828 return ContainerPtrToValuePtr<ValueType>(ContainerPtr, ArrayIndex);
829 }
830 return nullptr;
831 }
832 template<typename ValueType>
833 inline ValueType* ContainerPtrToValuePtrForDefaults(const UStruct* ContainerClass, void* ContainerPtr, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
834 {
835 if (ContainerPtr && IsInContainer(ContainerClass))
836 {
837 return ContainerPtrToValuePtr<ValueType>(ContainerPtr, ArrayIndex);
838 }
839 return nullptr;
840 }
841 template<typename ValueType>
842 inline const ValueType* ContainerPtrToValuePtrForDefaults(const UStruct* ContainerClass, const UObject* ContainerPtr, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
843 {
844 if (ContainerPtr && IsInContainer(ContainerClass))
845 {

852 {

856 }
857 return nullptr;

1460template<typename InTCppType>
1461class TPropertyTypeFundamentals
1462{
1463public:
1465 typedef InTCppType TCppType;
1466 enum
1467 {
1468 CPPSize = sizeof(TCppType),
1469 CPPAlignment = alignof(TCppType)
1470 };
1471
1472 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCHAR const* GetTypeName()
1473 {
1474 return TNameOf<TCppType>::GetName();
1475 }
1476
1478 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType const* GetPropertyValuePtr(void const* A)
1479 {
1480 return (TCppType const*)A;
1481 }
1482
1483 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType* GetPropertyValuePtr(void* A)
1484 {
1485 return (TCppType*)A;
1486 }
1487
1488 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType const& GetPropertyValue(void const* A)
1489 {
1490 return *GetPropertyValuePtr(A);
1491 }
1492
1493 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType GetDefaultPropertyValue()
1494 {
1495 return TCppType();
1496 }
1497
1498 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType GetOptionalPropertyValue(void const* B)
1499 {
1500 return B ? GetPropertyValue(B) : GetDefaultPropertyValue();
1501 }
1502
1503 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void SetPropertyValue(void* A, TCppType const& Value)
1504 {
1505 *GetPropertyValuePtr(A) = Value;
1506 }
1507
1508 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType* InitializePropertyValue(void* A)
1509 {
1510 return new (A) TCppType();
1511 }
1512
1513 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void DestroyPropertyValue(void* A)
1514 {
1515 GetPropertyValuePtr(A)->~TCppType();
1516 }
1517
1518 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState()
1519 {
1520 return ::HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState<TCppType>();
1521 }
1522
1523 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void InitializeIntrusiveUnsetOptionalValue(void* Data)
1524 {
1525 new(Data) TOptional<TCppType>();
1526 }
1527
1528 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool IsIntrusiveOptionalValueSet(const void* A)
1529 {
1530 return reinterpret_cast<const TOptional<TCppType>*>(A)->IsSet();
1531 }
1532
1533 static UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void ClearIntrusiveOptionalValue(void* A)
1534 {
1535 reinterpret_cast<TOptional<TCppType>*>(A)->Reset();
1536 }
1537
1538protected:
1540 static inline EPropertyFlags GetComputedFlagsPropertyFlags()
1541 {
1542 return
1543 (TIsPODType<TCppType>::Value ? CPF_IsPlainOldData : CPF_None)
1544 | (std::is_trivially_destructible_v<TCppType> ? CPF_NoDestructor : CPF_None)
1545 | (TIsZeroConstructType<TCppType>::Value ? CPF_ZeroConstructor : CPF_None)
1546 | (TModels_V<CGetTypeHashable, TCppType> ? CPF_HasGetValueTypeHash : CPF_None);
1547
1548 }
1549};

1552template<typename InTCppType, class TInPropertyBaseClass>
1553class TProperty : public TInPropertyBaseClass, public TPropertyTypeFundamentals<InTCppType>
1554{
1555public:
1556
1557 typedef InTCppType TCppType;
1558 typedef TInPropertyBaseClass Super;
1559 typedef TPropertyTypeFundamentals<InTCppType> TTypeFundamentals;

1561 TProperty(EInternal InInernal, FFieldClass* InClass)

1564 }

1572 TProperty(FFieldVariant InOwner, const FName& InName, EObjectFlags InObjectFlags) : TProperty(InOwner, InName) {}
1573
1579 template <typename PropertyParamsType>
1580 TProperty(FFieldVariant InOwner, PropertyParamsType& Prop)
1581 : Super(InOwner, Prop, TTypeFundamentals::GetComputedFlagsPropertyFlags())
1582 {
1583 this->SetElementSize(TTypeFundamentals::CPPSize);
1584 }

1586#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
1587 template<typename... Ts>
1588 explicit consteval TProperty(
1589 // Args must be the common parameters to FProperty's constructor followed by properties unique to TInPropertyBaseClass
1590 UE::CodeGen::ConstInit::FPropertyParams InBaseParams,
1591 Ts&&... AdditionalArgs
1592 )
1593 : Super(InBaseParams.SetElementSize(TTypeFundamentals::CPPSize), Forward<Ts>(AdditionalArgs)...)
1594 {
1595 }
1596#endif
1597
1598public:
1599
1600#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA

1602 : Super(InField)
1603 {
1604 this->SetElementSize(TTypeFundamentals::CPPSize);

1608 // UHT interface
1609 virtual FString GetCPPType( FString* ExtendedTypeText=NULL, uint32 CPPExportFlags=0 ) const override
1610 {
1611 return FString(TTypeFundamentals::GetTypeName());
1612 }

1614
1615 // FProperty interface.
1616 virtual int32 GetMinAlignment() const override
1617 {
1618 return TTypeFundamentals::CPPAlignment;
1619 }
1620 virtual void LinkInternal(FArchive& Ar) override
1621 {
1622 this->SetElementSize(TTypeFundamentals::CPPSize);
1623 this->PropertyFlags |= TTypeFundamentals::GetComputedFlagsPropertyFlags();
1624
1625 }
1626 virtual void CopyValuesInternal( void* Dest, void const* Src, int32 Count ) const override
1627 {
1628 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Count; Index++)
1629 {
1630 TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValuePtr(Dest)[Index] = TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValuePtr(Src)[Index];
1631 }
1632 }
1633 virtual void ClearValueInternal( void* Data ) const override
1634 {

1636 }
1637 virtual void InitializeValueInternal( void* Dest ) const override
1638 {
1639 for (int32 i = 0; i < this->ArrayDim; ++i)
1640 {
1641 TTypeFundamentals::InitializePropertyValue((uint8*)Dest + i * static_cast<size_t>(this->GetElementSize()));
1642 }
1643 }
1644 virtual void DestroyValueInternal( void* Dest ) const override
1645 {
1646 for (int32 i = 0; i < this->ArrayDim; ++i)
1647 {
1648 TTypeFundamentals::DestroyPropertyValue((uint8*)Dest + i * static_cast<size_t>(this->GetElementSize()));
1649 }
1650 }

1654 {

1656 }

1659 {

1661 }

1663 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType const& GetPropertyValue_InContainer(void const* A, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
1664 {

1666 }
1667
1668 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT TCppType GetOptionalPropertyValue_InContainer(void const* B, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
1669 {
1670 return B ? GetPropertyValue_InContainer(B, ArrayIndex) : TTypeFundamentals::GetDefaultPropertyValue();
1671 }
1672
1673 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void SetPropertyValue_InContainer(void* A, TCppType const& Value, int32 ArrayIndex = 0) const
1674 {
1675 *GetPropertyValuePtr_InContainer(A, ArrayIndex) = Value;
1676 }
1677
1678 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void SetValue_InContainer(void* OutContainer, const TCppType& InValue) const
1679 {
1680 TInPropertyBaseClass::SetValue_InContainer(OutContainer, &InValue);
1681 }
1682
1683 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void GetValue_InContainer(void const* InContainer, TCppType* OutValue) const
1684 {
1685 TInPropertyBaseClass::GetValue_InContainer(InContainer, OutValue);
1686 }
1687
1688 virtual bool HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState() const override
1689 {
1690 return TTypeFundamentals::HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState();
1691 }
1692
1693 virtual void InitializeIntrusiveUnsetOptionalValue(void* Data) const override
1694 {
1695 TTypeFundamentals::InitializeIntrusiveUnsetOptionalValue(Data);
1696 }
1697
1698 virtual bool IsIntrusiveOptionalValueSet(const void* Data) const override
1699 {
1700 return TTypeFundamentals::IsIntrusiveOptionalValueSet(Data);
1701 }
1702
1703 virtual void ClearIntrusiveOptionalValue(void* Data) const override
1704 {
1705 TTypeFundamentals::ClearIntrusiveOptionalValue(Data);
1706 }
1707 // End of FProperty interface

1710template<typename InTCppType, class TInPropertyBaseClass>
1711class TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer : public TProperty<InTCppType, TInPropertyBaseClass>
1712{
1713
1714public:
1715 typedef TProperty<InTCppType, TInPropertyBaseClass> Super;
1716 typedef InTCppType TCppType;
1717 typedef typename Super::TTypeFundamentals TTypeFundamentals;
1718
1719 TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(EInternal InInernal, FFieldClass* InClass)
1720 : Super(EC_InternalUseOnlyConstructor, InClass)
1721 {
1722 }
1723
1724 TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(FFieldVariant InOwner, const FName& InName)
1725 : Super(InOwner, InName)
1726 {
1727 }
1728 UE_DEPRECATED(5.8, "TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer constructor with InObjectFlags is deprecated, remove that parameter.")
1729 TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(FFieldVariant InOwner, const FName& InName, EObjectFlags InObjectFlags) : TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(InOwner, InName) {}
1730
1736 TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(FFieldVariant InOwner, const UECodeGen_Private::FPropertyParamsBaseWithOffset& Prop)
1737 : Super(InOwner, Prop)
1738 {
1739 }
1740
1741#if UE_WITH_CONSTINIT_UOBJECT
1742 template<typename... Ts>
1743 explicit consteval TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(
1744 UE::CodeGen::ConstInit::FPropertyParams InBaseParams,
1745 Ts&&... Args
1746 )
1747 : Super(InBaseParams, Forward<Ts>(Args)...)
1748 {
1749 }
1750#endif
1751
1752#if WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
1753 explicit TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer(UField* InField)
1754 : Super(InField)
1755 {
1756 }
1757#endif // WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA
1758
1759 // FProperty interface.
1760 virtual bool Identical(TNotNull<const void*> A, const void* B, uint32 PortFlags = 0) const override
1761 {
1762 // `B` can be null, but we want to avoid the cost of copying a non-null `B` if we were to just use
1763 // `TTypeFundamentals::GetOptionalPropertyValue(B)`. It is important that we branch on `B` here
1764 // rather than using a ternary between the two variants of B (its own value or the default), because
1765 // `TTypeFundamentals::GetDefaultPropertyValue()` returns a non-ref, and thus doing a ternary would
1766 // also result in a copy of `B` which we are trying to avoid!
1767 if (B)
1768 {
1769 return TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(A) == TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(B);
1770 }
1771 else
1772 {
1773 return TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(A) == TTypeFundamentals::GetDefaultPropertyValue();
1774 }
1775 }
1776
1777 virtual void SerializeItem(FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, TNotNull<void*> Value, void const* Defaults) const override
1778 {
1779 Slot << *TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValuePtr(Value);
1780 }
1781 // End of FProperty interface
1782
1783};

1824 template <typename T>
1825 bool CanHoldValue(T Value) const
1826 {
1827 if (std::is_floating_point_v<T>)
1828 {
1829 //@TODO: FLOATPRECISION: This feels wrong, it might be losing precision before it tests to see if it's going to lose precision...
1830 return CanHoldDoubleValueInternal((double)Value);
1831 }
1832 else if (std::is_signed_v<T>)
1833 {
1834 return CanHoldSignedValueInternal(Value);
1835 }
1836 else
1837 {
1838 return CanHoldUnsignedValueInternal(Value);
1839 }
1840 }

1844 {

1923class TProperty_Numeric : public TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer<InTCppType, FNumericProperty>
1924{
1925public:
1926 typedef TProperty_WithEqualityAndSerializer<InTCppType, FNumericProperty> Super;
1927 typedef InTCppType TCppType;
1928 typedef typename Super::TTypeFundamentals TTypeFundamentals;
1929

1931 : Super(EC_InternalUseOnlyConstructor, InClass)
1932 {
1933 }

1936 : Super(InOwner, InName)
1937 {

1949 {

1965
1966 // FProperty interface
1967 virtual uint32 GetValueTypeHashInternal(const void* Src) const override
1968 {
1969 return GetTypeHash(*(const InTCppType*)Src);
1970 }
1971
1972protected:
1973 template <typename OldNumericType>
1974 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void ConvertFromArithmeticValue(FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, void* Obj, const FPropertyTag& Tag) const
1975 {
1976 TConvertAndSet<OldNumericType, TCppType>(*this, Slot, Obj, Tag);
1977 }
1978
1979private:
1980 template <typename FromType, typename ToType>
1981 struct TConvertAndSet
1982 {
1983 TConvertAndSet(const TProperty_Numeric& Property, FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, void* Obj, const FPropertyTag& Tag)
1984 {
1985 FromType OldValue;
1986 Slot << OldValue;
1987 ToType NewValue = (ToType)OldValue;
1988 Property.SetPropertyValue_InContainer(Obj, NewValue, Tag.ArrayIndex);
1989
1990 UE_CLOG(
1991 ((std::is_signed_v<FromType> || std::is_floating_point_v<FromType>) && (!std::is_signed_v<ToType> && !std::is_floating_point_v<ToType>) && OldValue < 0) || ((FromType)NewValue != OldValue),
1992 LogClass,
1993 Warning,
1994 TEXT("Potential data loss during conversion of integer property %s of %s - was (%s) now (%s) - for package: %s"),
1995 *Property.GetName(),
1996 *Slot.GetUnderlyingArchive().GetArchiveName(),
1997 *LexToString(OldValue),
1998 *LexToString(NewValue),
1999 *Slot.GetUnderlyingArchive().GetArchiveName()
2000 );
2001 }
2002 };
2003
2004 template <typename SameType>
2005 struct TConvertAndSet<SameType, SameType>
2006 {
2007 inline TConvertAndSet(const TProperty_Numeric& Property, FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, void* Obj, const FPropertyTag& Tag)
2008 {
2009 SameType Value;
2010 Slot << Value;
2011 Property.SetPropertyValue_InContainer(Obj, Value, Tag.ArrayIndex);
2012 }
2013 };
2014
2015public:
2016 virtual EConvertFromTypeResult ConvertFromType(const FPropertyTag& Tag, FStructuredArchive::FSlot Slot, uint8* Data, const UStruct* DefaultsStruct, const uint8* Defaults) override
2017 {
2018 if (const EName* TagType = Tag.Type.ToEName(); TagType && Tag.Type.GetNumber() == NAME_NO_NUMBER_INTERNAL)
2019 {
2020 PRAGMA_DISABLE_SWITCH_UNHANDLED_ENUM_CASE_WARNINGS;
2021 switch (*TagType)
2022 {
2023 case NAME_Int8Property:
2024 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<int8>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2025 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, int8> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2026
2027 case NAME_Int16Property:
2028 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<int16>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2029 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, int16> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2030
2031 case NAME_IntProperty:
2032 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<int32>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2033 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, int32> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2034
2035 case NAME_Int64Property:
2036 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<int64>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2037 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, int64> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2038
2039 case NAME_ByteProperty:
2040 if (Tag.GetType().GetParameterCount() >= 1)
2041 {
2042 int64 PreviousValue = this->ReadEnumAsInt64(Slot, DefaultsStruct, Tag);
2043 this->SetPropertyValue_InContainer(Data, (TCppType)PreviousValue, Tag.ArrayIndex);
2044 return EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2045 }
2046 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<int8>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2047 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, uint8> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2048
2049 case NAME_EnumProperty:
2050 {
2051 int64 PreviousValue = this->ReadEnumAsInt64(Slot, DefaultsStruct, Tag);
2052 this->SetPropertyValue_InContainer(Data, (TCppType)PreviousValue, Tag.ArrayIndex);
2053 return EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2054 }
2055
2056 case NAME_UInt16Property:
2057 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<uint16>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2058 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, uint16> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2059
2060 case NAME_UInt32Property:
2061 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<uint32>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2062 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, uint32> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2063
2064 case NAME_UInt64Property:
2065 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<uint64>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2066 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, uint64> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2067
2068 case NAME_FloatProperty:
2069 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<float>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2070 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, float> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2071
2072 case NAME_DoubleProperty:
2073 ConvertFromArithmeticValue<double>(Slot, Data, Tag);
2074 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, double> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2075
2076 case NAME_BoolProperty:
2077 this->SetPropertyValue_InContainer(Data, (TCppType)Tag.BoolVal, Tag.ArrayIndex);
2078 return std::is_same_v<TCppType, bool> ? EConvertFromTypeResult::Serialized : EConvertFromTypeResult::Converted;
2079
2080 default:
2081 // We didn't convert it
2082 break;
2083 }
2084 PRAGMA_RESTORE_SWITCH_UNHANDLED_ENUM_CASE_WARNINGS;
2085 }
2086
2087 return EConvertFromTypeResult::UseSerializeItem;
2088 }
2089 // End of FProperty interface
2090
2091 // FNumericProperty interface.
2092 virtual bool IsFloatingPoint() const override
2093 {
2094 return std::is_floating_point_v<TCppType>;
2095 }
2096 virtual bool IsInteger() const override
2097 {
2098 return std::is_integral_v<TCppType>;
2099 }
2100 virtual void SetIntPropertyValue(void* Data, uint64 Value) const override
2101 {
2102 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2103 TTypeFundamentals::SetPropertyValue(Data, (TCppType)Value);
2104 }
2105 virtual void SetIntPropertyValue(void* Data, int64 Value) const override
2106 {
2107 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2108 TTypeFundamentals::SetPropertyValue(Data, (TCppType)Value);
2109 }
2110 virtual void SetFloatingPointPropertyValue(void* Data, double Value) const override
2111 {
2112 check(std::is_floating_point_v<TCppType>);
2113 TTypeFundamentals::SetPropertyValue(Data, (TCppType)Value);
2114 }
2115 virtual void SetNumericPropertyValueFromString(void* Data, TCHAR const* Value) const override
2116 {
2117 LexFromString(*TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValuePtr(Data), Value);
2118 }
2119 virtual void SetNumericPropertyValueFromString_InContainer(void* Container, TCHAR const* Value) const override
2120 {
2121 TCppType LocalValue{};
2122 LexFromString(LocalValue, Value);
2123 FNumericProperty::SetValue_InContainer(Container, &LocalValue);
2124 }
2125 virtual FString GetNumericPropertyValueToString(void const* Data) const override
2126 {
2127 return LexToString(TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(Data));
2128 }
2129 virtual FString GetNumericPropertyValueToString_InContainer(void const* Container) const override
2130 {
2131 TCppType LocalValue{};
2132 FNumericProperty::GetValue_InContainer(Container, &LocalValue);
2133 return LexToString(LocalValue);
2134 }
2135 virtual int64 GetSignedIntPropertyValue(void const* Data) const override
2136 {
2137 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2138 return (int64)TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(Data);
2139 }
2140 virtual int64 GetSignedIntPropertyValue_InContainer(void const* Container) const override
2141 {
2142 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2143 TCppType LocalValue{};
2144 FNumericProperty::GetValue_InContainer(Container, &LocalValue);
2145 return (int64)LocalValue;
2146 }
2147 virtual uint64 GetUnsignedIntPropertyValue(void const* Data) const override
2148 {
2149 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2150 return (uint64)TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(Data);
2151 }
2152 virtual uint64 GetUnsignedIntPropertyValue_InContainer(void const* Container) const override
2153 {
2154 check(std::is_integral_v<TCppType>);
2155 TCppType LocalValue{};
2156 FNumericProperty::GetValue_InContainer(Container, &LocalValue);
2157 return (uint64)LocalValue;
2158 }
2159 virtual double GetFloatingPointPropertyValue(void const* Data) const override
2160 {
2161 check(std::is_floating_point_v<TCppType>);
2162 return (double)TTypeFundamentals::GetPropertyValue(Data);
2163 }
2164 // End of FNumericProperty interface
2165
2166private:
2167 virtual bool CanHoldDoubleValueInternal(double Value) const
2168 {
2169 return (double)(InTCppType)Value == Value;
2170 }
2171
2172 virtual bool CanHoldSignedValueInternal(int64 Value) const
2173 {
2174 return (int64)(InTCppType)Value == Value;
2175 }
2176
2177 virtual bool CanHoldUnsignedValueInternal(uint64 Value) const
2178 {
2179 return (uint64)(InTCppType)Value == Value;
2180 }
2181};

2936 // Disable false positive buffer overrun warning during pgoprofile linking step
2937 PGO_LINK_DISABLE_WARNINGS
2938 /* Helper functions for UObject property types that wrap the object pointer in a smart pointer */
2939 template <typename T, typename OutType>
2940 void GetWrappedUObjectPtrValues(OutType* OutObjects, const void* SrcAddress, EPropertyMemoryAccess SrcAccess, int32 ArrayIndex, int32 ArrayCount) const
2941 {
2942 // Outgoing values are expected to be UObject* or TObjectPtr
2943 static_assert((std::is_pointer_v<OutType> && std::is_convertible_v<OutType, const UObject*>) || TIsTObjectPtr_V<OutType>);
2944
2945 // Ensure required range is valid
2946 checkf(ArrayIndex >= 0 && ArrayCount >= 0 && ArrayIndex <= ArrayDim && ArrayCount <= ArrayDim && ArrayIndex <= ArrayDim - ArrayCount, TEXT("ArrayIndex (%d) and ArrayCount (%d) is invalid for an array of size %d"), ArrayIndex, ArrayCount, ArrayDim);
2947
2948 if (SrcAccess == EPropertyMemoryAccess::InContainer)
2949 {
2950 if (HasGetter())
2951 {
2952 if (ArrayCount == 1)
2953 {
2954 // Slower but no mallocs. We can copy the value directly to the resulting param
2955 T Value;
2956 GetValue_InContainer(SrcAddress, &Value);
2957 *OutObjects = Value.Get();
2958 }
2959 else
2960 {
2961 // Malloc a temp value that is the size of the array. Getter will then copy the entire array to the temp value
2962 T* ValueArray = (T*)AllocateAndInitializeValue();
2963 FProperty::GetValue_InContainer(SrcAddress, ValueArray);
2964
2965 // Grab the items we care about and free the temp array
2966 int32 LocalElementSize = GetElementSize();
2967 for (int32 OutIndex = 0; OutIndex != ArrayCount; ++OutIndex)
2968 {
2969 OutObjects[OutIndex] = ValueArray[ArrayIndex + OutIndex].Get();
2970 }
2971 DestroyAndFreeValue(ValueArray);
2972 }
2973
2974 return;
2975 }
2976
2977 SrcAddress = ContainerPtrToValuePtr<void>(SrcAddress, ArrayIndex);
2978 }
2979
2980 // Fast path - direct memory access
2981 if (ArrayCount == 1)
2982 {
2983 *OutObjects = GetObjectPropertyValue(SrcAddress);
2984 }
2985 else
2986 {
2987 int32 LocalElementSize = GetElementSize();
2988 for (int32 OutIndex = 0; OutIndex != ArrayCount; ++OutIndex)
2989 {
2990 OutObjects[OutIndex] = GetObjectPropertyValue((const uint8*)SrcAddress + OutIndex * LocalElementSize);
2991 }
2992 }
2993 }
2994 // Enable back buffer overrun warning
2995 PGO_LINK_ENABLE_WARNINGS
2996
2997 template <typename T, typename ValueType>
2998 void SetWrappedUObjectPtrValues(void* DestAddress, EPropertyMemoryAccess DestAccess, ValueType* InValues, int32 ArrayIndex, int32 ArrayCount) const
2999 {
3000 // Incoming values are expected to be UObject* or TObjectPtr
3001 static_assert((std::is_pointer_v<ValueType> && std::is_convertible_v<ValueType, const UObject*>) || TIsTObjectPtr_V<ValueType>);
3002
3003 // Ensure required range is valid
3004 checkf(ArrayIndex >= 0 && ArrayCount >= 0 && ArrayIndex <= ArrayDim && ArrayCount <= ArrayDim && ArrayIndex <= ArrayDim - ArrayCount, TEXT("ArrayIndex (%d) and ArrayCount (%d) is invalid for an array of size %d"), ArrayIndex, ArrayCount, ArrayDim);
3005
3006 if (DestAccess == EPropertyMemoryAccess::InContainer)
3007 {
3008 if (HasSetter())
3009 {
3010 if (ArrayCount == 1)
3011 {
3012 // Slower but no mallocs. We can copy a local wrapped value directly to the resulting param
3013 T WrappedValue(*InValues);
3014 SetValue_InContainer(DestAddress, &WrappedValue);
3015 }
3016 else
3017 {
3018 // Malloc a temp value that is the size of the array. Getter will then copy the entire array to the temp value
3019 T* ValueArray = (T*)AllocateAndInitializeValue();
3020 FProperty::GetValue_InContainer(DestAddress, ValueArray);
3021
3022 // Replace the items we care about
3023 int32 LocalElementSize = GetElementSize();
3024 for (int32 OutIndex = 0; OutIndex != ArrayCount; ++OutIndex)
3025 {
3026 ValueArray[ArrayIndex + OutIndex] = InValues[OutIndex];
3027 }
3028
3029 // Now copy the entire array back to the property using a setter
3030 SetValue_InContainer(DestAddress, ValueArray);
3031 DestroyAndFreeValue(ValueArray);
3032 }
3033
3034 return;
3035 }
3036
3037 DestAddress = ContainerPtrToValuePtr<void>(DestAddress, ArrayIndex);
3038 }
3039
3040 // Fast path - direct memory access
3041 if (ArrayCount == 1)
3042 {
3043 SetObjectPropertyValue(DestAddress, *InValues);
3044 }
3045 else
3046 {
3047 int32 LocalElementSize = GetElementSize();
3048 for (int32 OutIndex = 0; OutIndex != ArrayCount; ++OutIndex)
3049 {
3050 SetObjectPropertyValue((uint8*)DestAddress + OutIndex * LocalElementSize, InValues[OutIndex]);
3051 }
3052 }
3053 }
3054};

3118 return (EnumHasAnyFlags(InReferenceType, EPropertyObjectReferenceType::Strong) && !TIsWeakPointerType<InTCppType>::Value)
3119 || (EnumHasAnyFlags(InReferenceType, EPropertyObjectReferenceType::Weak) && TIsWeakPointerType<InTCppType>::Value)
3120 || (EnumHasAnyFlags(InReferenceType, EPropertyObjectReferenceType::Soft) && TIsSoftObjectPointerType<InTCppType>::Value);
3121 }
3122 // End of FProperty interface
3123};

3221 virtual bool HasIntrusiveUnsetOptionalState() const
3222 {
3223 // If an object pointer is marked as non-nullable, then nullptr can be used as an intrusive unset state
3224 // At present, no C++ properties can be marked with this flag because TOptional<UObject*> and TOptional<TObjectPtr<UObject>>

3226 return (PropertyFlags & CPF_NonNullable) != 0;

3230 {

3235 {

3237 return GetPropertyValue(Data) != nullptr;
3238 }

3241 {
3242 checkSlow(!IsNative());
3243 ClearValue(Data);
3244 }

4054 /*
4055 * Helper function to get the number of key/value pairs inside of a map.
4056 * Used by the garbage collector where for performance reasons the provided map pointer is not guarded
4057 */
4058 int32 GetNum(void* InMap) const
4059 {
4060 return WithScriptMap(InMap, [](auto* Map) { return Map->Num(); });
4061 }
4062
4063 /*
4064 * Helper function to get the sizeof of the map's key/value pair.
4065 * Used by the garbage collector.
4066 */
4067 int32 GetPairStride() const
4068 {
4069 return MapLayout.SetLayout.Size;
4070 }
4071
4072 /*
4073 * Helper function to check if the specified index of a key/value pair in the underlying set is valid.
4074 * Used by the garbage collector where for performance reasons the provided map pointer is not guarded
4075 */
4076 bool IsValidIndex(void* InMap, int32 InternalIndex) const
4077 {
4078 return WithScriptMap(InMap, [InternalIndex](auto* Map) { return Map->IsValidIndex(InternalIndex); });
4079 }
4080
4081 /*
4082 * Helper function to get the pointer to a key/value pair at the specified index.
4083 * Used by the garbage collector where for performance reasons the provided map pointer is not guarded
4084 */
4085 uint8* GetPairPtr(void* InMap, int32 InternalIndex) const
4086 {
4087 return WithScriptMap(InMap, [this, InternalIndex](auto* Map) { return (uint8*)Map->GetData(InternalIndex, MapLayout); });
4088 }
4089
4090 const FProperty* GetKeyProperty() const
4091 {
4092 return KeyProp;
4093 }
4094
4095 const FProperty* GetValueProperty() const
4096 {
4097 return ValueProp;
4098 }

4262class FScriptArrayHelper
4263{
4264 enum EInternal { Internal };
4265
4266 template <typename CallableType>
4267 auto WithScriptArray(CallableType&& Callable) const
4268 {
4269 if (!!(ArrayFlags & EArrayPropertyFlags::UsesMemoryImageAllocator))
4270 {
4271 return Callable(FreezableArray);
4272 }
4273 else
4274 {
4275 return Callable(HeapArray);
4276 }
4277 }
4278
4279public:
4285 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT FScriptArrayHelper(const FArrayProperty* InProperty, const void* InArray)
4286 : FScriptArrayHelper(Internal, InProperty->Inner, InArray, InProperty->Inner->GetElementSize(), InProperty->Inner->GetMinAlignment(), InProperty->ArrayFlags)
4287 {
4288 }
4289
4295 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool IsValidIndex( int32 Index ) const
4296 {
4297 return Index >= 0 && Index < Num();
4298 }
4299
4303 inline int32 Num() const
4304 {
4305 int32 Result = WithScriptArray([](auto* Array) { return Array->Num(); });
4306 checkSlow(Result >= 0);
4307 return Result;
4308 }
4309
4314 inline int32 NumUnchecked() const
4315 {
4316 int32 Result = WithScriptArray([](auto* Array) { return Array->NumUnchecked(); });
4317 return Result;
4318 }
4319
4324 inline uint8* GetRawPtr(int32 Index = 0)
4325 {
4326 if (!Num())
4327 {
4328 checkSlow(!Index);
4329 return NULL;
4330 }
4331 checkSlow(IsValidIndex(Index));
4332 return (uint8*)WithScriptArray([](auto* Array) { return Array->GetData(); }) + Index * static_cast<size_t>(ElementSize);
4333 }
4334
4340 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT uint8* GetElementPtr(int32 Index = 0)
4341 {
4342 return GetRawPtr(Index);
4343 }
4344
4348 void EmptyAndAddValues(int32 Count)
4349 {
4350 check(Count>=0);
4351 checkSlow(Num() >= 0);
4352 EmptyValues(Count);
4353 AddValues(Count);
4354 }
4355
4359 void EmptyAndAddUninitializedValues(int32 Count)
4360 {
4361 check(Count>=0);
4362 checkSlow(Num() >= 0);
4363 EmptyValues(Count);
4364 AddUninitializedValues(Count);
4365 }
4366
4372 bool ExpandForIndex(int32 Index)
4373 {
4374 check(Index>=0);
4375 checkSlow(Num() >= 0);
4376 if (Index >= Num())
4377 {
4378 AddValues(Index - Num() + 1);
4379 return true;
4380 }
4381 return false;
4382 }
4383
4387 void Resize(int32 Count)
4388 {
4389 if (Count < 0)
4390 {
4391 UE::Core::Private::OnInvalidArrayNum(Count);
4392 }
4393
4394 int32 OldNum = Num();
4395 if (Count > OldNum)
4396 {
4397 AddValues(Count - OldNum);
4398 }
4399 else if (Count < OldNum)
4400 {
4401 RemoveValues(Count, OldNum - Count);
4402 }
4403 }
4404
4409 int32 AddValues(int32 Count)
4410 {
4411 const int32 OldNum = AddUninitializedValues(Count);
4412 ConstructItems(OldNum, Count);
4413 return OldNum;
4414 }
4415
4419 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT int32 AddValue()
4420 {
4421 return AddValues(1);
4422 }
4423
4428 int32 AddUninitializedValues(int32 Count)
4429 {
4430 check(Count>=0);
4431 checkSlow(Num() >= 0);
4432 const int32 OldNum = WithScriptArray([this, Count](auto* Array) { return Array->Add(Count, ElementSize, ElementAlignment); });
4433 return OldNum;
4434 }
4435
4439 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT int32 AddUninitializedValue()
4440 {
4441 return AddUninitializedValues(1);
4442 }
4443
4448 void InsertValues( int32 Index, int32 Count = 1)
4449 {
4450 check(Count>=0);
4451 check(Index>=0 && Index <= Num());
4452 WithScriptArray([this, Index, Count](auto* Array) { Array->Insert(Index, Count, ElementSize, ElementAlignment); });
4453 ConstructItems(Index, Count);
4454 }
4455
4459 void EmptyValues(int32 Slack = 0)
4460 {
4461 checkSlow(Slack>=0);
4462 const int32 OldNum = NumUnchecked();
4463 if (OldNum)
4464 {
4465 DestructItems(0, OldNum);
4466 }
4467 if (OldNum || Slack)
4468 {
4469 WithScriptArray([this, Slack](auto* Array) { Array->Empty(Slack, ElementSize, ElementAlignment); });
4470 }
4471 }
4472
4477 void RemoveValues(int32 Index, int32 Count = 1)
4478 {
4479 check(Count>=0);
4480 check(Index>=0 && Index + Count <= Num());
4481 DestructItems(Index, Count);
4482 WithScriptArray([this, Index, Count](auto* Array) { Array->Remove(Index, Count, ElementSize, ElementAlignment); });
4483 }
4484
4490 void ClearValues(int32 Index, int32 Count = 1)
4491 {
4492 check(Count>=0);
4493 check(Index>=0);
4494 ClearItems(Index, Count);
4495 }
4496
4502 void SwapValues(int32 A, int32 B)
4503 {
4504 WithScriptArray([this, A, B](auto* Array) { Array->SwapMemory(A, B, ElementSize); });
4505 }
4506
4512 void MoveAssign(void* InOtherArray)
4513 {
4514 checkSlow(InOtherArray);
4515 // FScriptArray::MoveAssign does not call destructors for our elements, so do that before calling it.
4516 DestructItems(0, Num());
4517 WithScriptArray([this, InOtherArray](auto* Array) { Array->MoveAssign(*static_cast<decltype(Array)>(InOtherArray), ElementSize, ElementAlignment); });
4518 }
4519
4524 void CountBytes( FArchive& Ar ) const
4525 {
4526 WithScriptArray([this, &Ar](auto* Array) { Array->CountBytes(Ar, ElementSize); });
4527 }
4528
4532 void DestroyContainer_Unsafe()
4533 {
4534 WithScriptArray([](auto* Array) { DestructItem(Array); });
4535 }
4536
4537 static FScriptArrayHelper CreateHelperFormInnerProperty(const FProperty* InInnerProperty, const void *InArray, EArrayPropertyFlags InArrayFlags = EArrayPropertyFlags::None)
4538 {
4539 return FScriptArrayHelper(Internal, InInnerProperty, InArray, InInnerProperty->GetElementSize(), InInnerProperty->GetMinAlignment(), InArrayFlags);
4540 }
4541
4542private:
4543 FScriptArrayHelper(EInternal, const FProperty* InInnerProperty, const void* InArray, int32 InElementSize, uint32 InElementAlignment, EArrayPropertyFlags InArrayFlags)
4544 : InnerProperty(InInnerProperty)
4545 , ElementSize(InElementSize)
4546 , ElementAlignment(InElementAlignment)
4547 , ArrayFlags(InArrayFlags)
4548 {
4549 //@todo, we are casting away the const here
4550 if (!!(InArrayFlags & EArrayPropertyFlags::UsesMemoryImageAllocator))
4551 {
4552 FreezableArray = (FFreezableScriptArray*)InArray;
4553 }
4554 else
4555 {
4556 HeapArray = (FScriptArray*)InArray;
4557 }
4558
4559 check(ElementSize > 0);
4560 check(InnerProperty);
4561 }
4562
4568 void ConstructItems(int32 Index, int32 Count)
4569 {
4570 checkSlow(Count >= 0);
4571 checkSlow(Index >= 0);
4572 checkSlow(Index <= Num());
4573 checkSlow(Index + Count <= Num());
4574 if (Count > 0)
4575 {
4576 uint8* Dest = GetRawPtr(Index);
4577 if (InnerProperty->PropertyFlags & CPF_ZeroConstructor)
4578 {
4579 FMemory::Memzero(Dest, Count * static_cast<size_t>(ElementSize));
4580 }
4581 else
4582 {
4583 for (int32 LoopIndex = 0; LoopIndex < Count; LoopIndex++, Dest += ElementSize)
4584 {
4585 InnerProperty->InitializeValue(Dest);
4586 }
4587 }
4588 }
4589 }
4595 void DestructItems(int32 Index, int32 Count)
4596 {
4597 if (!(InnerProperty->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor)))
4598 {
4599 checkSlow(Count >= 0);
4600 checkSlow(Index >= 0);
4601 checkSlow(Index + Count <= Num());
4602 if (Count > 0)
4603 {
4604 uint8* Dest = GetRawPtr(Index);
4605 for (int32 LoopIndex = 0; LoopIndex < Count; LoopIndex++, Dest += ElementSize)
4606 {
4607 InnerProperty->DestroyValue(Dest);
4608 }
4609 }
4610 }
4611 }
4617 void ClearItems(int32 Index, int32 Count)
4618 {
4619 checkSlow(Count >= 0);
4620 checkSlow(Index >= 0);
4621 checkSlow(Index < Num());
4622 checkSlow(Index + Count <= Num());
4623 if (Count > 0)
4624 {
4625 uint8* Dest = GetRawPtr(Index);
4626 if ((InnerProperty->PropertyFlags & (CPF_ZeroConstructor | CPF_NoDestructor)) == (CPF_ZeroConstructor | CPF_NoDestructor))
4627 {
4628 FMemory::Memzero(Dest, Count * static_cast<size_t>(ElementSize));
4629 }
4630 else
4631 {
4632 for (int32 LoopIndex = 0; LoopIndex < Count; LoopIndex++, Dest += ElementSize)
4633 {
4634 InnerProperty->ClearValue(Dest);
4635 }
4636 }
4637 }
4638 }
4639
4640 const FProperty* InnerProperty;
4641 union
4642 {
4643 FScriptArray* HeapArray;
4644 FFreezableScriptArray* FreezableArray;
4645 };
4646 int32 ElementSize;
4647 uint32 ElementAlignment;
4648 EArrayPropertyFlags ArrayFlags;
4649};

4674template<typename ContainerType>
4675struct TScriptContainerIterator
4676{
4677 explicit TScriptContainerIterator(const ContainerType& InContainer) : Container(InContainer)
4678 {
4679 Advance();
4680 }
4681
4682 explicit TScriptContainerIterator(const ContainerType& InContainer, const int32 InLogicalIndex) : Container(InContainer)
4683 {
4684 const int32 MaxIndex = Container.GetMaxIndex();
4685 if (MaxIndex == Container.Num())
4686 {
4687 InternalIndex = InLogicalIndex;
4688 LogicalIndex = InLogicalIndex;
4689 return;
4690 }
4691
4692 do
4693 {
4694 Advance();
4695 }
4696 while (LogicalIndex < InLogicalIndex && InternalIndex < MaxIndex);
4697 }
4698
4699 TScriptContainerIterator& operator++()
4700 {
4701 Advance();
4702 return *this;
4703 }
4704
4705 TScriptContainerIterator operator++(int)
4706 {
4707 const TScriptContainerIterator Temp(*this);
4708 Advance();
4709 return Temp;
4710 }
4711
4712 explicit operator bool() const
4713 {
4714 return Container.IsValidIndex(InternalIndex);
4715 }
4716
4717 int32 GetInternalIndex() const
4718 {
4719 return InternalIndex;
4720 }
4721
4722 int32 GetLogicalIndex() const
4723 {
4724 return LogicalIndex;
4725 }
4726
4727private:
4728 const ContainerType& Container;
4729 int32 InternalIndex = INDEX_NONE;
4730 int32 LogicalIndex = INDEX_NONE;
4731
4732 void Advance()
4733 {
4734 ++InternalIndex;
4735 const int32 MaxIndex = Container.GetMaxIndex();
4736 while (InternalIndex < MaxIndex && !Container.IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
4737 {
4738 ++InternalIndex;
4739 }
4740
4741 ++LogicalIndex;
4742 }
4743};

5172 void RemoveAt(int32 InternalIndex, int32 Count = 1)
5173 {
5174 return WithScriptMap([this, InternalIndex, Count](auto* Map)
5175 {
5176 check(Map->IsValidIndex(InternalIndex));
5177
5178 // Checking against max as sparse sets may want to remove a range including invalid items, so num is not a correct validation here
5179 check(InternalIndex + Count <= Map->Max());
5180
5181#if UE_USE_COMPACT_SET_AS_DEFAULT
5182 auto GetHashKey = [this](const void* ElementKey)
5183 {
5184 return KeyProp->GetValueTypeHash(ElementKey);
5185 };
5186
5187 auto DestroyElement = [this](void* Element)
5188 {
5189 if (!(KeyProp->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor)))
5190 {
5191 KeyProp->DestroyValue(Element);
5192 }
5193 void* ValuePtr = (uint8*)Element + MapLayout.ValueOffset;
5194 if (!(ValueProp->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor)))
5195 {
5196 ValueProp->DestroyValue(ValuePtr);
5197 }
5198 };
5199
5200 // Last element will get swapped into current spot, so go in reverse so everything moves safely
5201 for (int32 Index = InternalIndex + Count - 1; Index >= InternalIndex; --Index)
5202 {
5203 Map->RemoveAt(Index, MapLayout, GetHashKey, DestroyElement);
5204 }
5205#else
5206 DestructItems(InternalIndex, Count);
5207 for (int32 LocalCount = Count, LocalIndex = InternalIndex; LocalCount; ++LocalIndex)
5208 {
5209 if (Map->IsValidIndex(LocalIndex))
5210 {
5211 Map->RemoveAt(LocalIndex, MapLayout);
5212 --LocalCount;
5213 }
5214 }
5215#endif
5216 });
5217 }

5230 int32 FindInternalIndex(int32 LogicalIdx) const
5231 {
5232 return WithScriptMap([this, LogicalIdx](auto* Map) -> int32
5233 {
5234 int32 LocalLogicalIdx = LogicalIdx;
5235 if (LocalLogicalIdx < 0 || LocalLogicalIdx >= Map->Num())
5236 {
5237 return INDEX_NONE;
5238 }
5239
5240 // if map is compact, use random access
5241 if (Num() == GetMaxIndex())
5242 {
5243 return IsValidIndex(LogicalIdx) ? LogicalIdx : INDEX_NONE;
5244 }
5245
5246 int32 MaxIndex = Map->GetMaxIndex();
5247 for (int32 Actual = 0; Actual < MaxIndex; ++Actual)
5248 {
5249 if (Map->IsValidIndex(Actual))
5250 {
5251 if (LocalLogicalIdx == 0)
5252 {
5253 return Actual;
5254 }
5255 --LocalLogicalIdx;
5256 }
5257 }
5258 return INDEX_NONE;
5259 });
5260 }

5267 int32 FindLogicalIndex(int32 InternalIdx) const
5268 {
5269 return WithScriptMap([this, InternalIdx](auto* Map) -> int32
5270 {
5271 if( !IsValidIndex(InternalIdx) )
5272 {
5273 return INDEX_NONE;
5274 }
5275
5276 // if map is compact, use random access
5277 if (GetMaxIndex() == Num())
5278 {
5279 return InternalIdx;
5280 }
5281
5282 int32 LogicalIndex = InternalIdx;
5283 for (int i = 0; i < InternalIdx; ++i)
5284 {
5285 if (!IsValidIndex(i))
5286 {
5287 LogicalIndex--;
5288 }
5289 }
5290
5291 return LogicalIndex;
5292 });
5293 }

5304 int32 FindMapIndexWithKey(const void* PairWithKeyToFind, int32 IndexHint = 0) const
5305 {
5306 return WithScriptMap([this, PairWithKeyToFind, &IndexHint](auto* Map) -> int32
5307 {
5308 int32 MapMax = Map->GetMaxIndex();
5309 if (MapMax == 0)
5310 {
5311 return INDEX_NONE;
5312 }
5313
5314 if (IndexHint >= MapMax)
5315 {
5316 IndexHint = 0;
5317 }
5318
5319 check(IndexHint >= 0);
5320
5321 FProperty* LocalKeyProp = this->KeyProp; // prevent aliasing in loop below
5322
5323 int32 InternalIndex = IndexHint;
5324 for (;;)
5325 {
5326 if (Map->IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
5327 {
5328 const void* PairToSearch = Map->GetData(InternalIndex, MapLayout);
5329 if (LocalKeyProp->Identical(PairWithKeyToFind, PairToSearch))
5330 {
5331 return InternalIndex;
5332 }
5333 }
5334
5335 ++InternalIndex;
5336 if (InternalIndex == MapMax)
5337 {
5338 InternalIndex = 0;
5339 }
5340
5341 if (InternalIndex == IndexHint)
5342 {
5343 return INDEX_NONE;
5344 }
5345 }
5346 });
5347 }

5361 return Result;

5433 LocalValuePropForCapture->InitializeValue(NewElementValue);

5437 },

5441 },
5442 [LocalKeyPropForCapture](void* ElementKey)

5445 {
5446 LocalKeyPropForCapture->DestroyValue(ElementKey);
5447 }
5448 },

5567 void ConstructItem(int32 InternalIndex)
5568 {
5569 check(IsValidIndex(InternalIndex));
5570
5571 bool bZeroKey = !!(KeyProp ->PropertyFlags & CPF_ZeroConstructor);
5572 bool bZeroValue = !!(ValueProp->PropertyFlags & CPF_ZeroConstructor);
5573
5574 void* Dest = WithScriptMap([this, InternalIndex](auto* Map) { return Map->GetData(InternalIndex, MapLayout); });
5575
5576 if (bZeroKey || bZeroValue)
5577 {
5578 // If any nested property needs zeroing, just pre-zero the whole space
5579 FMemory::Memzero(Dest, MapLayout.SetLayout.Size);
5580 }
5581
5582 if (!bZeroKey)
5583 {
5584 KeyProp->InitializeValue_InContainer(Dest);
5585 }
5586
5587 if (!bZeroValue)
5588 {
5589 ValueProp->InitializeValue_InContainer(Dest);
5590 }
5591 }
5592
5596 void DestructItems(int32 InternalIndex, int32 Count)
5597 {
5598 check(InternalIndex >= 0);
5599 check(Count >= 0);
5600
5601 if (Count == 0)
5602 {
5603 return;
5604 }
5605
5606 bool bDestroyKeys = !(KeyProp ->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor));
5607 bool bDestroyValues = !(ValueProp->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor));
5608
5609 if (bDestroyKeys || bDestroyValues)
5610 {
5611 uint32 Stride = MapLayout.SetLayout.Size;
5612 uint8* PairPtr = WithScriptMap([this, InternalIndex](auto* Map) { return (uint8*)Map->GetData(InternalIndex, MapLayout); });
5613 if (bDestroyKeys)
5614 {
5615 if (bDestroyValues)
5616 {
5617 for (; Count; ++InternalIndex)
5618 {
5619 if (IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
5620 {
5621 KeyProp ->DestroyValue_InContainer(PairPtr);
5622 ValueProp->DestroyValue_InContainer(PairPtr);
5623 --Count;
5624 }
5625 PairPtr += Stride;
5626 }
5627 }
5628 else
5629 {
5630 for (; Count; ++InternalIndex)
5631 {
5632 if (IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
5633 {
5634 KeyProp->DestroyValue_InContainer(PairPtr);
5635 --Count;
5636 }
5637 PairPtr += Stride;
5638 }
5639 }
5640 }
5641 else
5642 {
5643 for (; Count; ++InternalIndex)
5644 {
5645 if (IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
5646 {
5647 ValueProp->DestroyValue_InContainer(PairPtr);
5648 --Count;
5649 }
5650 PairPtr += Stride;
5651 }
5652 }
5653 }
5654 }

6064 int32 FindInternalIndex(int32 LogicalIdx) const
6065 {
6066 if (LogicalIdx < 0 || LogicalIdx >= Num())
6067 {
6068 return INDEX_NONE;
6069 }
6070
6071 // if set is compact, use random access
6072 if (Num() == GetMaxIndex())
6073 {
6074 return IsValidIndex(LogicalIdx) ? LogicalIdx : INDEX_NONE;
6075 }
6076
6077 int32 MaxIndex = GetMaxIndex();
6078 for (int32 Actual = 0; Actual < MaxIndex; ++Actual)
6079 {
6080 if (IsValidIndex(Actual))
6081 {
6082 if (LogicalIdx == 0)
6083 {
6084 return Actual;
6085 }
6086 --LogicalIdx;
6087 }
6088 }
6089 return INDEX_NONE;
6090 }
6091
6097 int32 FindLogicalIndex(int32 InternalIdx) const
6098 {
6099 if (!IsValidIndex(InternalIdx))
6100 {
6101 return INDEX_NONE;
6102 }
6103
6104 // if set is compact, use random access
6105 if (GetMaxIndex() == Num())
6106 {
6107 return InternalIdx;
6108 }
6109
6110 int32 LogicalIndex = InternalIdx;
6111 for (int i = 0; i < InternalIdx; ++i)
6112 {
6113 if (!IsValidIndex(i))
6114 {
6115 LogicalIndex--;
6116 }
6117 }
6118
6119 return LogicalIndex;
6120 }
6121
6130 int32 FindElementIndex(const void* ElementToFind, int32 IndexHint = 0) const
6131 {
6132 const int32 SetMax = GetMaxIndex();
6133 if (SetMax == 0)
6134 {
6135 return INDEX_NONE;
6136 }
6137
6138 if (IndexHint >= SetMax)
6139 {
6140 IndexHint = 0;
6141 }
6142
6143 check(IndexHint >= 0);
6144
6145 FProperty* LocalKeyProp = this->ElementProp; // prevent aliasing in loop below
6146
6147 int32 InternalIndex = IndexHint;
6148 for (;;)
6149 {
6150 if (IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
6151 {
6152 const void* ElementToCheck = GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex);
6153 if (LocalKeyProp->Identical(ElementToFind, ElementToCheck))
6154 {
6155 return InternalIndex;
6156 }
6157 }
6158
6159 ++InternalIndex;
6160 if (InternalIndex == SetMax)
6161 {
6162 InternalIndex = 0;
6163 }
6164
6165 if (InternalIndex == IndexHint)
6166 {
6167 return INDEX_NONE;
6168 }
6169 }
6170 }
6171
6180 inline uint8* FindElementPtr(const void* ElementToFind, int32 IndexHint = 0)
6181 {
6182 const int32 InternalIndex = FindElementIndex(ElementToFind, IndexHint);
6183 uint8* Result = (InternalIndex >= 0 ? GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex) : nullptr);
6184 return Result;
6185 }
6186
6188 inline int32 FindElementIndexFromHash(const void* ElementToFind) const
6189 {
6190 FProperty* LocalElementPropForCapture = ElementProp;
6191 return Set->FindIndex(
6192 ElementToFind,
6193 SetLayout,
6194 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* Element) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->GetValueTypeHash(Element); },
6195 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* A, const void* B) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->Identical(A, B); }
6196 );
6197 }
6198
6200 inline uint8* FindElementPtrFromHash(const void* ElementToFind)
6201 {
6202 const int32 InternalIndex = FindElementIndexFromHash(ElementToFind);
6203 uint8* Result = (InternalIndex >= 0 ? GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex) : nullptr);
6204 return Result;
6205 }
6206
6208 void AddElement(const void* ElementToAdd)
6209 {
6210 FProperty* LocalElementPropForCapture = ElementProp;
6211 FScriptSetLayout& LocalSetLayoutForCapture = SetLayout;
6212 Set->Add(
6213 ElementToAdd,
6214 SetLayout,
6215 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* Element) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->GetValueTypeHash(Element); },
6216 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* A, const void* B) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->Identical(A, B); },
6217 [LocalElementPropForCapture, ElementToAdd, LocalSetLayoutForCapture](void* NewElement)
6218 {
6219 if (LocalElementPropForCapture->PropertyFlags & CPF_ZeroConstructor)
6220 {
6221 FMemory::Memzero(NewElement, LocalElementPropForCapture->GetSize());
6222 }
6223 else
6224 {
6225 LocalElementPropForCapture->InitializeValue(NewElement);
6226 }
6227
6228 LocalElementPropForCapture->CopySingleValueToScriptVM(NewElement, ElementToAdd);
6229 },
6230 [LocalElementPropForCapture](void* Element)
6231 {
6232 if (!(LocalElementPropForCapture->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor)))
6233 {
6234 LocalElementPropForCapture->DestroyValue(Element);
6235 }
6236 }
6237 );
6238 }
6239
6241 bool RemoveElement(const void* ElementToRemove)
6242 {
6243 FProperty* LocalElementPropForCapture = ElementProp;
6244 int32 FoundIndex = Set->FindIndex(
6245 ElementToRemove,
6246 SetLayout,
6247 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* Element) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->GetValueTypeHash(Element); },
6248 [LocalElementPropForCapture](const void* A, const void* B) { return LocalElementPropForCapture->Identical(A, B); }
6249 );
6250 if (FoundIndex != INDEX_NONE)
6251 {
6252 RemoveAt(FoundIndex);
6253 return true;
6254 }
6255 else
6256 {
6257 return false;
6258 }
6259 }
6260
6261 static FScriptSetHelper CreateHelperFormElementProperty(FProperty* InElementProperty, const void *InSet)
6262 {
6263 check(InElementProperty);
6264
6265 FScriptSetHelper ScriptSetHelper;
6266 ScriptSetHelper.ElementProp = InElementProperty;
6267 ScriptSetHelper.Set = (FScriptSet*)InSet;
6268
6269 const int32 ElementPropSize = InElementProperty->GetSize();
6270 const int32 ElementPropAlignment = InElementProperty->GetMinAlignment();
6271 ScriptSetHelper.SetLayout = FScriptSet::GetScriptLayout(ElementPropSize, ElementPropAlignment);
6272
6273 return ScriptSetHelper;
6274 }
6275
6276private:
6277 FScriptSetHelper()
6278 : ElementProp(nullptr)
6279 , Set(nullptr)
6280 , SetLayout(FScriptSet::GetScriptLayout(0, 1))
6281 {}
6282
6289 void ConstructItem(int32 InternalIndex)
6290 {
6291 check(IsValidIndex(InternalIndex));
6292
6293 bool bZeroElement = !!(ElementProp->PropertyFlags & CPF_ZeroConstructor);
6294 uint8* Dest = GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex);
6295
6296 if (bZeroElement)
6297 {
6298 // If any nested property needs zeroing, just pre-zero the whole space
6299 FMemory::Memzero(Dest, SetLayout.Size);
6300 }
6301
6302 if (!bZeroElement)
6303 {
6304 ElementProp->InitializeValue_InContainer(Dest);
6305 }
6306 }
6307
6311 void DestructItems(int32 InternalIndex, int32 Count)
6312 {
6313 check(InternalIndex >= 0);
6314 check(Count >= 0);
6315
6316 if (Count == 0)
6317 {
6318 return;
6319 }
6320
6321 bool bDestroyElements = !(ElementProp->PropertyFlags & (CPF_IsPlainOldData | CPF_NoDestructor));
6322
6323 if (bDestroyElements)
6324 {
6325 uint32 Stride = SetLayout.Size;
6326 uint8* ElementPtr = GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex);
6327
6328 for (; Count; ++InternalIndex)
6329 {
6330 if (IsValidIndex(InternalIndex))
6331 {
6332 ElementProp->DestroyValue_InContainer(ElementPtr);
6333 --Count;
6334 }
6335 ElementPtr += Stride;
6336 }
6337 }
6338 }
6339
6347 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT uint8* GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(int32 InternalIndex)
6348 {
6349 return (uint8*)Set->GetData(InternalIndex, SetLayout);
6350 }
6351
6359 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const uint8* GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(int32 InternalIndex) const
6360 {
6361 return const_cast<FScriptSetHelper*>(this)->GetElementPtrWithoutCheck(InternalIndex);
6362 }
6363
6364public:
6365 FProperty* ElementProp;
6366 FScriptSet* Set;
6367 FScriptSetLayout SetLayout;
6368};

6948 //default value. Add new enums to add new functionality.

7010 bool GetArrayIndicesPerObject(int32 InObjectIteratorIndex, TMap<FString, int32>& OutArrayIndicesPerObject) const

7135{

7138 IncludeDeprecated = 1<<1, // Include deprecated properties
7139 IncludeInterfaces = 1<<2, // Include interfaces
7140

7143 Default = IncludeSuper | IncludeDeprecated,

7164 ExcludeInterfaces = (uint8)EFieldIterationFlags::None,

7189//
7190// For iterating through a linked list of fields.
7191//
7192template <class T>
7193class TFieldIterator
7194{
7195private:
7197 const UStruct* Struct;
7199 typename T::BaseFieldClass* Field;
7201 int32 InterfaceIndex;
7203 const bool bIncludeSuper;
7205 const bool bIncludeDeprecated;
7207 const bool bIncludeInterface;
7208
7209public:
7210 TFieldIterator(const UStruct* InStruct, EFieldIterationFlags InIterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7211 : Struct ( InStruct )
7212 , Field ( InStruct ? GetChildFieldsFromStruct<typename T::BaseFieldClass>(InStruct) : NULL )
7213 , InterfaceIndex ( -1 )
7214 , bIncludeSuper ( EnumHasAnyFlags(InIterationFlags, EFieldIterationFlags::IncludeSuper) )
7215 , bIncludeDeprecated( EnumHasAnyFlags(InIterationFlags, EFieldIterationFlags::IncludeDeprecated) )
7216 , bIncludeInterface ( EnumHasAnyFlags(InIterationFlags, EFieldIterationFlags::IncludeInterfaces) && InStruct && InStruct->IsA(UClass::StaticClass()) )
7217 {
7218 IterateToNext();
7219 }
7220
7222 TFieldIterator(const UStruct* InStruct,
7223 EFieldIteratorFlags::SuperClassFlags InSuperClassFlags,
7224 EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags InDeprecatedFieldFlags = EFieldIteratorFlags::IncludeDeprecated,
7225 EFieldIteratorFlags::InterfaceClassFlags InInterfaceFieldFlags = EFieldIteratorFlags::ExcludeInterfaces)
7226 : TFieldIterator(InStruct, (EFieldIterationFlags)(InSuperClassFlags | InDeprecatedFieldFlags | InInterfaceFieldFlags))
7227 {
7228 }
7229
7231 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT explicit operator bool() const
7232 {
7233 return Field != NULL;
7234 }
7235
7236 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool operator !() const
7237 {
7238 return !(bool)*this;
7239 }
7240
7241 inline bool operator==(const TFieldIterator<T>& Rhs) const { return Field == Rhs.Field; }
7242 inline bool operator!=(const TFieldIterator<T>& Rhs) const { return Field != Rhs.Field; }
7243
7244 inline void operator++()
7245 {
7246 checkSlow(Field);
7247 Field = Field->Next;
7248 IterateToNext();
7249 }
7250 inline T* operator*()
7251 {
7252 checkSlow(Field);
7253 return (T*)Field;
7254 }
7255 inline const T* operator*() const
7256 {
7257 checkSlow(Field);
7258 return (const T*)Field;
7259 }
7260 inline T* operator->()
7261 {
7262 checkSlow(Field);
7263 return (T*)Field;
7264 }
7265 inline const UStruct* GetStruct()
7266 {
7267 return Struct;
7268 }
7269protected:
7270 inline void IterateToNext()
7271 {
7272 typename T::BaseFieldClass* CurrentField = Field;
7273 const UStruct* CurrentStruct = Struct;
7274
7275 while (CurrentStruct)
7276 {
7277 for (; CurrentField; CurrentField = CurrentField->Next)
7278 {
7279 typename T::FieldTypeClass* FieldClass = CurrentField->GetClass();
7280
7281 if (!FieldClass->HasAllCastFlags(T::StaticClassCastFlags()))
7282 {
7283 continue;
7284 }
7285
7286 if (FieldClass->HasAllCastFlags(CASTCLASS_FProperty))
7287 {
7288 FProperty* Prop = (FProperty*)CurrentField;
7289 if (Prop->HasAllPropertyFlags(CPF_Deprecated) && !bIncludeDeprecated)
7290 {
7291 continue;
7292 }
7293 }
7294
7295 Struct = CurrentStruct;
7296 Field = CurrentField;
7297 return;
7298 }
7299
7300 if (bIncludeInterface)
7301 {
7302 // We shouldn't be able to get here for non-classes
7303 UClass* CurrentClass = (UClass*)CurrentStruct;
7304 ++InterfaceIndex;
7305 if (InterfaceIndex < CurrentClass->Interfaces.Num())
7306 {
7307 FImplementedInterface& Interface = CurrentClass->Interfaces[InterfaceIndex];
7308 CurrentField = Interface.Class ? GetChildFieldsFromStruct<typename T::BaseFieldClass>(Interface.Class) : nullptr;
7309 continue;
7310 }
7311 }
7312
7313 if (bIncludeSuper)
7314 {
7315 CurrentStruct = CurrentStruct->GetInheritanceSuper();
7316 if (CurrentStruct)
7317 {
7318 CurrentField = GetChildFieldsFromStruct<typename T::BaseFieldClass>(CurrentStruct);
7319 InterfaceIndex = -1;
7320 continue;
7321 }
7322 }
7323
7324 break;
7325 }
7326
7327 Struct = CurrentStruct;
7328 Field = CurrentField;
7329 }
7330};
7331

7358
7359template <UE::CDerivedFrom<UField> T>
7360T* FindUField(const UStruct* Owner, FName FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7361{
7362 static_assert(sizeof(T) > 0, "T must not be an incomplete type");
7363
7364 // We know that a "none" field won't exist in this Struct
7365 if (FieldName.IsNone())
7366 {
7367 return nullptr;
7368 }
7369
7370 // Search by comparing FNames (INTs), not strings
7371 for (TFieldIterator<T>It(Owner, IterationFlags); It; ++It)
7372 {
7373 if (It->GetFName() == FieldName)
7374 {
7375 return *It;
7376 }
7377 }
7378
7379 // If we didn't find it, return no field
7380 return nullptr;
7381}
7382
7383template <UE::CDerivedFrom<UField> T>
7384T* FindUField(const UStruct* Owner, const TCHAR* FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7385{
7386 static_assert(sizeof(T) > 0, "T must not be an incomplete type");
7387
7388 // lookup the string name in the Name hash
7389 FName Name(FieldName, FNAME_Find);
7390 return FindUField<T>(Owner, Name, IterationFlags);
7391}
7392
7393template <UE::CDerivedFrom<FField> T>
7394T* FindFProperty(const UStruct* Owner, FName FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7395{
7396 static_assert(sizeof(T) > 0, "T must not be an incomplete type");
7397
7398 // We know that a "none" field won't exist in this Struct
7399 if (FieldName.IsNone())
7400 {
7401 return nullptr;
7402 }
7403
7404 // Search by comparing FNames (INTs), not strings
7405 for (TFieldIterator<T>It(Owner, IterationFlags); It; ++It)
7406 {
7407 if (It->GetFName() == FieldName)
7408 {
7409 return *It;
7410 }
7411 }
7412
7413 // If we didn't find it, return no field
7414 return nullptr;
7415}
7416
7417template <UE::CDerivedFrom<FField> T>
7418T* FindFProperty(const UStruct* Owner, const TCHAR* FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7419{
7420 static_assert(sizeof(T) > 0, "T must not be an incomplete type");
7421
7422 // lookup the string name in the Name hash
7423 FName Name(FieldName, FNAME_Find);
7424 return FindFProperty<T>(Owner, Name, IterationFlags);
7425}
7426
7428inline FFieldVariant FindUFieldOrFProperty(const UStruct* Owner, FName FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7429{
7430 // Look for properties first as they're most often the runtime thing higher level code wants to find
7431 FFieldVariant Result = FindFProperty<FProperty>(Owner, FieldName, IterationFlags);
7432 if (!Result)
7433 {
7434 Result = FindUField<UField>(Owner, FieldName, IterationFlags);
7435 }
7436 return Result;
7437}
7438
7440inline FFieldVariant FindUFieldOrFProperty(const UStruct* Owner, const TCHAR* FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)
7441{
7442 // lookup the string name in the Name hash
7443 FName Name(FieldName, FNAME_Find);
7444 return FindUFieldOrFProperty(Owner, Name, IterationFlags);
7445}

7448T* FindUFieldOrFProperty(const UStruct* Owner, FName FieldName, EFieldIterationFlags IterationFlags = EFieldIterationFlags::Default)

7477template<typename T>
7478T* FindFieldChecked( const UStruct* Scope, FName FieldName )
7479{
7480 if ( FieldName != NAME_None && Scope != NULL )
7481 {
7482 const UStruct* InitialScope = Scope;
7483 for ( ; Scope != NULL; Scope = dynamic_cast<const UStruct*>(Scope->GetOuter()) )
7484 {
7485 for ( TFieldIterator<T> It(Scope); It; ++It )
7486 {
7487 if ( It->GetFName() == FieldName )
7488 {
7489 return *It;
7490 }
7491 }
7492 }
7493
7494 UE_LOGF( LogType, Fatal, "Failed to find %ls %ls in %ls", *T::StaticClass()->GetName(), *FieldName.ToString(), *InitialScope->GetFullName() );
7495 }
7496
7497 return NULL;
7498}

7512class FPropertyValueIterator
7513{
7514public:
7515 using BasePairType = TPair<const FProperty*, const void*>;
7516
7526 COREUOBJECT_API explicit FPropertyValueIterator(FFieldClass* InPropertyClass, const UStruct* InStruct, const void* InStructValue,
7527 EPropertyValueIteratorFlags InRecursionFlags = EPropertyValueIteratorFlags::FullRecursion,
7528 EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags InDeprecatedPropertyFlags = EFieldIteratorFlags::IncludeDeprecated);
7529
7531 FPropertyValueIterator()
7532 : PropertyClass(nullptr)
7533 , RecursionFlags(EPropertyValueIteratorFlags::FullRecursion)
7534 , DeprecatedPropertyFlags(EFieldIteratorFlags::IncludeDeprecated)
7535 , bSkipRecursionOnce(false)
7536 {
7537 }
7538
7540 inline explicit operator bool() const
7541 {
7542 // If nothing left in the stack, iteration is complete
7543 if (PropertyIteratorStack.Num() > 0)
7544 {
7545 return true;
7546 }
7547 return false;
7548 }
7549
7550 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool operator==(const FPropertyValueIterator& Rhs) const
7551 {
7552 return PropertyIteratorStack == Rhs.PropertyIteratorStack;
7553 }
7554
7555 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool operator!=(const FPropertyValueIterator& Rhs) const
7556 {
7557 return !(PropertyIteratorStack == Rhs.PropertyIteratorStack);
7558 }
7559
7561 inline const BasePairType& operator*() const
7562 {
7563 const FPropertyValueStackEntry& Entry = PropertyIteratorStack.Last();
7564 return Entry.GetPropertyValue();
7565 }
7566
7567 inline const BasePairType* operator->() const
7568 {
7569 const FPropertyValueStackEntry& Entry = PropertyIteratorStack.Last();
7570 return &Entry.GetPropertyValue();
7571 }
7572
7574 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const FProperty* Key() const
7575 {
7576 return (*this)->Key;
7577 }
7578
7580 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const void* Value() const
7581 {
7582 return (*this)->Value;
7583 }
7584
7586 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void operator++()
7587 {
7588 IterateToNext();
7589 }
7590
7592 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT void SkipRecursiveProperty()
7593 {
7594 bSkipRecursionOnce = true;
7595 }

7635 struct FPropertyValueStackEntry
7636 {
7638 const void* Owner = nullptr;
7639
7641 typedef TPair<BasePairType, EPropertyValueFlags> BasePairAndFlags;
7642 typedef TArray<BasePairAndFlags, TInlineAllocator<8>> FValueArrayType;
7643 FValueArrayType ValueArray;
7644
7646 int32 ValueIndex = -1;
7647
7649 int32 NextValueIndex = 0;
7650
7651 FPropertyValueStackEntry(const void* InValue)
7652 : Owner(InValue)
7653 {}
7654
7655 FPropertyValueStackEntry(const UStruct* InStruct, const void* InValue, EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags InDeprecatedPropertyFlags)
7656 : Owner(InValue)
7657 {}
7658
7659 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT bool operator==(const FPropertyValueStackEntry& Rhs) const
7660 {
7661 return Owner == Rhs.Owner && ValueIndex == Rhs.ValueIndex;
7662 }
7663
7664 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const BasePairType& GetPropertyValue() const
7665 {
7666 // Index has to be valid to get this far
7667 return ValueArray[ValueIndex].Key;
7668 }
7669 };
7670
7672 TArray<FPropertyValueStackEntry, TInlineAllocator<8>> PropertyIteratorStack;
7673
7675 FFieldClass* PropertyClass = nullptr;
7676
7678 const EPropertyValueIteratorFlags RecursionFlags;
7679
7681 const EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags DeprecatedPropertyFlags;
7682
7684 bool bSkipRecursionOnce = false;
7685
7687 bool bMatchAll = false;
7688
7690 EPropertyValueFlags GetPropertyValueFlags(const FProperty* Property) const;
7691
7693 void FillStructProperties(const UStruct* Struct, FPropertyValueStackEntry& Entry);
7694
7699 bool NextValue(EPropertyValueIteratorFlags RecursionFlags);
7700
7702 COREUOBJECT_API void IterateToNext();
7703};

7706template <class T>
7707class TPropertyValueIterator : public FPropertyValueIterator
7708{
7709public:
7710 using PairType = TPair<const T*, const void*>;
7711
7720 explicit TPropertyValueIterator(const UStruct* InStruct, const void* InStructValue,
7721 EPropertyValueIteratorFlags InRecursionFlags = EPropertyValueIteratorFlags::FullRecursion,
7722 EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags InDeprecatedPropertyFlags = EFieldIteratorFlags::IncludeDeprecated)
7723 : FPropertyValueIterator(T::StaticClass(), InStruct, InStructValue, InRecursionFlags, InDeprecatedPropertyFlags)
7724 {
7725 }
7726
7728 TPropertyValueIterator() = default;
7729
7731 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const PairType& operator*() const
7732 {
7733 return (const PairType&)FPropertyValueIterator::operator*();
7734 }
7735
7736 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const PairType* operator->() const
7737 {
7738 return (const PairType*)FPropertyValueIterator::operator->();
7739 }
7740
7742 UE_FORCEINLINE_HINT const T* Key() const
7743 {
7744 return (*this)->Key;
7745 }
7746};

7760 TPropertyValueRange(const UStruct* InStruct, const void* InStructValue,

7762 EFieldIteratorFlags::DeprecatedPropertyFlags InDeprecatedPropertyFlags = EFieldIteratorFlags::IncludeDeprecated)
7763 : Begin(InStruct, InStructValue, InRecursionFlags, InDeprecatedPropertyFlags)
7764 {

7766
7767 friend TPropertyValueIterator<T> begin(const TPropertyValueRange& Range) { return Range.Begin; }

7776inline bool UObject::IsBasedOnArchetype( const UObject* const SomeObject ) const
7777{
7778 checkfSlow(this, TEXT("IsBasedOnArchetype() is called on a null pointer. Fix the call site."));
7779 if ( SomeObject != this )
7780 {
7781 for ( UObject* Template = GetArchetype(); Template; Template = Template->GetArchetype() )
7782 {
7783 if ( SomeObject == Template )
7784 {
7785 return true;
7786 }
7787 }
7788 }
7789
7790 return false;
7791}
